Accused of foul sorcery, a young woman escapes into a strange manor...

Explore quirky rooms, experiment with unspoken rules, use magic to solve playful puzzles and help eccentric residents. Comfort hums with unease and weirdness becomes the clue in this cozy-horror narrative-puzzle game where refuge is only the beginning.

With fire and force!

Explore and interact with the manor and its interior. Use Telekinesis and Pyromancy to move, collide, place, and ignite objects in order to solve puzzles. 

Meet strange residents

Stumble upon odd characters and help them in their quests. Follow their clues to unlock new areas and progress the story.

A DADIU Graduation Game

This game was lovingly summoned in just 6 weeks by a team of 13 students during the 2025 autumn semester of the DADIU program in Denmark. Kiwi Crew Games now cordially invites you to the dark and cozy home of Manorism!
